page.overview:
Who is Asset 87?

Asset 87, also referred to as The Spino, is the main antagonist of Jurassic Park III. He is a male individual Spinosaurus from the Rescue of Eric Kirby. During the incident, he chased plane survivors across Isla Sorna before being deterred by fire. 14 years later, he was caught and experimented on by Mantah Corp on Mantah Corp Island and had several encounters with the Nublar Six.

Different in appearance compared to his prehistoric forebearer's current depiction and as well as Ile Saint-Hubert's Spinosaurus, Asset 87 which was made as an amalgamation testing appears in his contemporary 1990s depiction which used to be accurate at that time. The body color of Asset 87 was a mixture of dark and light gray, a yellowed underbelly, and red splotches around his face, across his back, and at the end of his tail. The sail had blue circles, possibly for attracting the opposite sex. Like all of InGen's cloned theropods, he has pronated wrists. Asset 87 had strong jaws, powerful forearms, immense strength, a thick hide, and a more terrestrial lifestyle The skull also had several differences from the original, such as being slightly broader and bearing two head crests on each side of the snout instead of just one crest in the middle of the snout. Most of his snout and his teeth resembled Baryonyx with an estimated 76 teeth in the dinosaur's palate. He also lacks the paddle-like tail, a trait seen in his predecessor. He has tall hind legs like all theropods instead of short hind legs. This Spinosaurus is a male. In Camp Cretaceous, he still uses his outdated depiction, yet Asset 87 is full grown. His size is now similar to Rexy's size. When he was put in the desert biome in Mantah Corp Island, his coloration had changed. The gray body has turn into a tan body with desert-like peach on his pattern, the color of his sail has become brown and tan with some dark coloration patterns and splotches. The head is brown with white pattern and the skin near his eyes is brown, with his green eyes remaining the same.

Asset 87 exhibits aggressive behavior, which may be influenced by human presence as well as the gene modifications and amalgam testing. It is possible that humans provoke the Asset 87 to vocalize in order to defend his territory, rather than seeking to prey on them. In one instance, when attacked by a human with a gun, Asset 87 retaliated by chasing and killing the attacker. This incident likely heightened his aggression, particularly when injured or feeling threatened by other stimuli, such as a jet. Consequently, he actively searched for humans and directed his aggression towards them, driven by a desire for revenge and sustenance.

Furthermore, Asset 87 has demonstrated his formidable nature by successfully engaging in combat with the Tyrannosaur Bull, ultimately overpowering and killing him. This predator is highly adaptable, capable of hunting both on land and in water, which further contributes to his prowess as a hunter.
